notes: FieldView keeps explicit null distinct from absent; null presence falls back to [presence] explicit_null and fill to the policy column then [fill] mode.

Planner is a Dijkstra search over (schema, tracked field states) ordered by (cost, edge-id list), so schemas may be revisited, prerequisites are read on the state reached and ties pick the lexicographically smallest plan; results are cached on the registry.
Executor applies pinned corrections on first arrival at their schema and checks prerequisites before each edge, returning a failed result with E_PREREQ_FAILED.

Pipeline orders lines by received_seq then line, keys replay identity on the canonical partner, makes the first partner-resolved record the holder, matches null tokens exactly and computes receipts over manifest-batch lines from the line as received.
